page_title: LAZ 0-1 LEC | Lazio v Lecce 25/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Mario Gila (Lazio) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
90+3' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) receives a red card after his awful challenge. He completely lost his temper and referee Michael Fabbri sends him off the pitch.
90+3' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' That's the end of the game for Nikola Krstovic, who is replaced by Rares Burnete (Lecce).
87' Pedro (Lazio) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
86' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
81' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
80' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
77' Fabrizio Del Rosso has decided to substitute Mattia Zaccagni and he is replaced by Tijjani Noslin (Lazio).
77' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nicolo Rovella as he is replaced by Matias Vecino (Lazio).
75' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
73' Marco Giampaolo has decided to make a change. Danilo Veiga (Lecce) replaces Ylber Ramadani.
73' The referee allows time for a substitution. Nuno Tavares will be replaced by Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
69' Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) picks up a yellow card.
69' The possession of the ball – 69:31.
68' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
66' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

65' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Wladimiro Falcone, who pulls off a comfortable save!
60' Here is a change. Medon Berisha is going off and Marco Giampaolo gives the last tactical orders to Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
59' Substitution. Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) in, Jesper Karlsson out.
59' Pedro (Lazio) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
57' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
57' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the corner with a short pass.
57' Pedro (Lazio) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
55' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Nuno Tavares (Lazio).

54' Fine attempt! Medon Berisha (Lecce) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
50' Medon Berisha (Lecce) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
49' It looks like Nuno Tavares (Lazio) saw red with that tackle. Michael Fabbri won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Adam Marusic is replaced by Elseid Hysaj (Lazio).
46' Fabrizio Del Rosso makes a switch. Pedro (Lazio) is coming on in place of Gustav Isaksen at the start of the second period.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Ante Rebic (Lecce) is shown a red card even though he is not on the pitch. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
45+2' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' 0 - 1 Goal! Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:1.
41' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

41' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Lecce force a corner. They send men into the box.
37' A yellow card for a tackle by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce). Michael Fabbri doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
36' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.
35' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Lazio will have a corner.
32' Michael Fabbri shows the yellow card to Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) for a heavy challenge.
31' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
31' The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
28' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
27' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Adam Marusic (Lazio).
23' The ratio of the ball possession is 54:46.
23' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lecce.
22' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
21' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. A free kick has been awarded to Lecce.
17' Lecce are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
16' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is behind the touchline and Lecce will take a throw-in.
12' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) takes it short.
11' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) commits a foul and Michael Fabbri immediately signals a free kick.
9' The corner is swung in but Lecce can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
7' Looks like Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

4' Medon Berisha (Lecce) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
1' The first half has just begun.
Lecce will kick-off.
Michael Fabbri will supervise the game today.
